task_summary: Implemented simultaneous Academic Paper and Academic Journal archival upload with configurable OCR metadata extraction and plagiarism scan targets, separate submission section, zero minimum upload requirement, and interactive paper/journal viewing toggle in the archive viewer: 1) Fixed Axios baseURL /api duplication in CanonicalDocumentViewer, added activeDocType state with institutional toggle buttons ('Academic Paper' vs 'Academic Journal'), dynamic URL streaming (/projects/:id/manuscript?type=...), and dynamic download filenames. 2) Extended project.service.js getProject and searchArchive to return hasAcademicPaper and hasJournalPaper, and getProjectManuscript to stream requested document types without cross-type bleed. 3) Updated ExistingCapstoneUploadPage to allow simultaneous multi-file selection, individual document removal, dedicated OCR Metadata Target selector with manual re-extraction trigger, Plagiarism Target selector with integrated plagiarism scan trigger and score display, and a cleanly separated Section 4 Confirm & Upload Archive Bundle card. 4) Added bulkUploadSchema validation and projectService.bulkUploadArchive persistence for metadataTarget, plagiarismTarget, and originalityScore. Passed 8/8 upload page tests, 7/7 document viewer tests, 5/5 server manuscript tests, 209/190 endpoint parity (UNMATCHED_COUNT=0), 60/60 agentic validation checks, clean governance pipeline, and 11-point Playwright visual audit across light and dark desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844).

verification.playwright_visual_audit: 11 screenshots verified across desktop light/dark and mobile
